Package dev.turboism.sdk.config

package dev.turboism.sdk.config
Plugin-scoped configuration schemas, migrations, and optimistic-revision persistence results.

Plugins access configuration through PluginContext.config(). The runtime owns paths, validation, migration execution, I/O scheduling, and trust boundaries.
